papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe by combining two desirable ingredients: on-policy student-generated trajectories and dense token-level teacher supervision. Yet how this hybrid training regime shapes a model remains poorly understood. We characterize the sparsity and geometry of OPD parameter updates across several language and vision-language model pairs and application settings. OPD updates are small and coordinate-sparse at checkpoint precision, while remaining distributed across layers and modules. This sparse support is operationally meaningful: masked training on the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full-training performance. At the matrix level, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated. Their visible supports avoid coordinates emphasized by the source's principal structure and favor low-magnitude source coordinates, while the source singular-value spectra change little. Together, these findings show that OPD exhibits important weight-space signatures of on-policy post-training despite using dense teacher supervision.

analysis.key_results: OPD更新虽小且坐标稀疏，但跨层分布；掩码训练子网络可近似恢复完整训练性能；更新矩阵数值满秩但能量集中；更新避免源模型主结构方向，偏好低量值坐标。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次系统表征了在策蒸馏参数更新的稀疏性与几何结构，揭示了其权重空间特征。
analysis.method: 通过实验分析语言和视觉-语言模型对在策蒸馏的参数更新稀疏性、秩、谱特性及掩码训练效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文分析了在策蒸馏（OPD）参数更新的稀疏性和几何特性，发现更新虽小且坐标稀疏但跨层分布，并且通过掩码训练可恢复大部分性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究在策蒸馏的更新稀疏性，属于模型训练效率分析，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但对VLA/WAM模型的训练效率优化有潜在方法学参考价值。
